name: @patryk/basecoat-factory
description: Prebuilt platform assets for Basecoat, HTMX, Alpine, and Jinja apps

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p dist && cp node_modules/basecoat-css/dist/js/all.min.js dist/basecoat-js.min.js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js dist/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js dist/alpine.min.js
